newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Dunloe buys Santry firm for 11.15 mln punts.
newsitem.headline: Dunloe buys Santry firm for 11.15 mln punts.

text.p: Property company Dunloe House Group Plc said on Tuesday that it had agreed to acquire Santry Holding Company for 11.15 million punts.
Santry Holding owns eight units at Airways Industrial Estate in Dublin, Dunloe said in a statement.
Dunloe said it plans to dispose of a number of units, all of which are currently let to state body Forfas, generating annual rents of about 0.85 million punts.
The property group said it has already received a number of enquiries in respect of individual units and blocks of units.
